teaching_language: Entirely English ("Il corso è tenuto in lingua inglese"; English manifesto: "entirely delivered in English"). One optional course, Planetology, remains in Italian.
places_available: CONFLICT: the 2026-2027 Regolamento states a sustainable capacity of 65 ("l'utenza sostenibile è quantificata in 65 Studenti"); the older UNIPG course-sheet 'Conoscenze richieste' box says 50. The 2026-2027 Regolamento (newer) is treated as authoritative: 65. No numero programmato.
academic_requirements: Curricular requirements automatically satisfied for L-34 (Scienze Geologiche), plus L-30 (Scienze e Tecnologie Fisiche) and L-7 (Ingegneria Civile e Ambientale) per the UNIPG sheet, and their pre-2001 (D.M. 509/99, class 16) equivalents. Other bachelor's degrees: at least 60 CFU across CHIM, FIS, MAT and GEO sectors combined, of which at least 36 CFU in GEO sectors. Otherwise a commission evaluates via curriculum review and an interview if needed, and may prescribe integrative CFU in Area 04 Earth Sciences (GEOS) to be completed before the nulla-osta deadline (generally end of February). Personal-preparation check is via interview ("colloquio") in all cases requiring one. No minimum GPA stated.
language_requirements: English B2, submitted via the Universitaly platform during application. Alternative evidence accepted for candidates not requiring a visa: at least one year of secondary school in English, an Italian secondary school with English-medium instruction, or a degree taught in English — otherwise the Commission assesses B2-equivalence via interview or another certificate.
english_certificates_accepted: (alt. evidence) 1+ year of English-medium secondary schooling, or a degree taught in English
entry_exam_or_test: No standardised written test. Personal-preparation check always via an interview ("La verifica della preparazione personale dello Studente viene effettuata tramite un colloquio"), required for all applicants, with a basic-training expectation in maths, physics, chemistry and geological sciences.
nulla_osta_required: Yes — M0415 is on UNIPG's online nulla-osta list (via SOL, from 3 Aug 2026); deadline generally coincides with end of February for candidates needing integrative CFU.
required_documents: Bachelor's degree, preferably in Geology or Earth-Science-related field
Degree certificate translated into English or Italian
English proficiency certificate for non-native speakers
application_deadline_eu: EU/legally-residing applicants: PICA pre-enrolment from 1 July 2026 (no published closing date); SOL enrolment for open-access master closes 1 March 2027 (department notes the practical cut-off generally coincides with end of February).
application_deadline_non_eu: Non-EU visa applicants: PICA call 2026-visa-02, open until 12:00 noon on 30 September 2026 or until the visa quota is filled — STILL OPEN as of research date (2026-09-05), the only item in this set that is. Note: the Regolamento PDF itself cites an older code, 2026-visa-01; the central international-students page's 2026-visa-02 is current.
tuition_range: €150–2,200/year depending on family income/merit. Flat Tax (4 UNDP-2016-index brackets) for family-abroad students, or ISEEU Parificato via an affiliated CAF. Declaration window 3 Aug–20 Oct 2026 (late fee to 1 Mar 2027).
cimea_requirement: Not specified at programme level; see university-wide study-documents page for CIMEA/blackout-date rules.
double_degree: None. Department notes numerous international collaboration agreements (mobility/Erasmus only, not a double degree).
